comment: Read from src/SplitStack.cpp at the tag release/v2.1.1, commit f622217, which is the installed 2.1.1. The README spells the section heading Spit/Stack. A part that is not playing has its outputs set to zero channels rather than to 0V (SplitStack.cpp:200 onwards), which is what makes a downstream synth go quiet rather than hold a note. The split test is strictly below the split point for part A and at or above it for part B (SplitStack.cpp:157). Learning the split point looks for the gate rising by more than 1V from its previous value (SplitStack.cpp:141), so a gate already high when the button is held does not set it.
